CREATE TABLE "public"."Car" (
  "accidentFree" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "brand" text NOT NULL,
  "carvertical" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "color" text NOT NULL,
  "condition" text NOT NULL,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "doors" text NOT NULL,
  "drive" text NOT NULL,
  "engine" text NOT NULL,
  "equipment" text[] NOT NULL,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "fuel" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "interior" text NOT NULL,
  "invoice" text DEFAULT 'VAT MARŻA' NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "mileage" text NOT NULL,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "negotiation" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "power" text NOT NULL,
  "price" text NOT NULL,
  "seats" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'available' NOT NULL,
  "statusType" text DEFAULT 'sale' NOT NULL,
  "transmission" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "vin" text NOT NULL,
  "voivodeship" text NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Car_equipment_elem_not_null_a3f3a8f5" CHECK (array_position("equipment", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CarImage" (
  "carId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPrimary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
